rationale: Several papers, such as 2407.07980, 2607.02801, 2507.06709, 2503.01213, 2510.19924, and 2504.08041, provide substantive new evidence on the role of AGN feedback in regulating star formation and galaxy evolution across different mass scales and cosmic times. However, the question is not fully settled as the complexity and variability of AGN feedback effects are still being explored.
